description: Diagnose device, app, development-server, and React Native or Expo readiness issues. Returns compact evidence for local inventory, sessions, optional app discovery, toolchains, and server reachability. For Metro reachability, run doctor locally on the Metro host from your project directory. On iOS simulators doctor also warms the XCTest runner build cache in the background when missing. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

remote.description: Check remote connection setup instead of local device inventory.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

targetApp.description: Installed app package/bundle id or app name to verify without opening a session.

name: doctor
title: Diagnose device, app, dev-server, and RN/Expo readiness
